scope: Read-only review of iteration4 artifacts and the three local RTC/received-speech scripts. No inference, raw edits, staging, or process termination performed.

credentials.result: No private credential or access-token candidate observed.
checks: Readable artifact text and script scan for private-key headers, JWTs, common provider token prefixes, and Authorization credentials.
Inspection of credential assignment candidates and script serialization paths.
Decoded and scanned every payload_base64 packet in the ten events.jsonl files.
credentials.intentional_public_credentials: The loopback development configuration uses devkey/secret; ten apiKey log entries contain that public devkey. These are intentional local examples, not private credentials.
credentials.serialization: The capture driver builds the RTC token in memory and does not serialize it or credential environment variables; the worker receipt excludes credential values. The scripts retain invocation and local source/sample provenance.
credentials.limits: This is a bounded pattern and source review, not a proof that arbitrary secrets cannot occur. Binary PCM/WAV files were inventoried, not listened to for this check.

size_snapshot.finding: No oversized individual file observed; largest file is approximately 1.7 MB. The roughly 45 MB aggregate includes preserved PCM, convenient WAV copies, and resampled ASR inputs.
size_snapshot.git_ignore: Representative received PCM, received WAV, and worker log paths are not ignored. The existing results/**/raw/ rule does not exclude these iteration4 paths.
size_snapshot.limits: Inventory is a point-in-time snapshot while final documentation and review artifacts may still be added.

cleanup.supported_claim: The task-owned LiveKit server, MLX server, and PRISM worker from local-stack-run1 stopped.
cleanup.command_identity: All three recorded commands match their observed commands in the cleanup receipt before SIGTERM.
cleanup.verification: Read-only os.kill(pid, 0) returned ProcessLookupError for all three PIDs. lsof returned no TCP listeners on 7880/8081/8082 or UDP socket on 7882 (exit 1, empty output). Separate exit receipts substantiate cleanup.json despite its null returncode fields.
cleanup.limits: This supports stopping these three experiment processes, not a claim about every unrelated local process.

publication_notes: Local absolute paths and the development username remain in provenance; observed speech artifacts derive from the declared synthetic navigation experiment.
The received-speech audit labels transcription as an ASR proxy and preserves its limits; this artifact review makes no listening-quality or physical playback-latency claim.
